typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	G_Dw_Run_Key as integer (),
	G_Run_End_DT as timestamp ()
}

source(output(
		HolderNo as string,
		HolderName as string,
		GetCardFlag as integer,
		DepartmentNo as string,
		EmployeeID as integer,
		CardNo as string,
		HolderNo1 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT Distinct Right(\'0000\' + LTRIM( RTRIM( HolderNo ) ), 4 ) AS HolderNo,HolderNo as HolderNo1, HolderName,GetCardFlag, \'01\' as DepartmentNo,CardNo, EmployeeID FROM HolderData WHERE HolderName NOT LIKE \'%Temp%\' and HolderName NOT LIKE \'%Access%\' and HolderName NOT LIKE \'%card%\'',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> HOLDERDATASQLDATASRC	source(output(
		HolderName as string,
		FromDate as date,
		ToDate as date,
		HolderNo as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT     HolderName, MIN(IODate) AS FromDate, MAX(IODate) AS ToDate, HolderNo FROM         IOData WHERE     (CardNo <> \'XXXX\')  AND (HolderName NOT LIKE \'%Temp%\')  AND (HolderName NOT LIKE \'%Training Room Card%\')  AND (HolderName NOT LIKE \'%Tmp%\') GROUP BY HolderName, HolderNo',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LKPFROMTODATELKPTABLE	source(output(
		Dw_Holder_Key as integer,
		Holder_Number as string,
		Holder_Name as string,
		Card_Number as string,
		DW_Run_Key as integer,
		DW_Create_Dt as timestamp,
		From_Dt as timestamp,
		To_Dt as timestamp,
		Card_Flag as boolean,
		EmployeeID as integer,
		LastUpdate_Dt as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT     Dw_Holder_Key, Holder_Number, Holder_Name, Card_Number, DW_Run_Key, DW_Create_Dt, From_Dt, To_Dt, Card_Flag, EmployeeID,LastUpdate_Dt FROM         dbo.DIM_HOLDER',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
HOLDERDATASQLDATASRC,LKPFROMTODATELKPTABLE lookup(HolderNo1 == LKPFROMTODATELKPTABLE@HolderNo,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> LKPFROMTODATE
LKPFROMTODATE select(mapColumn(
		HolderNo = HOLDERDATASQLDATASRC@HolderNo,
		HolderName = HOLDERDATASQLDATASRC@HolderName,
		GetCardFlag = GetCardFlag,
		DepartmentNo = DepartmentNo,
		EmployeeID = EmployeeID,
		CardNo = CardNo,
		HolderNo1 = HolderNo1,
		FromDate = FromDate,
		ToDate = ToDate
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> LKPFROMTODATE0
LKPFROMTODATE0 split(isMatch(), disjoint: true) ~> LKPFROMTODATEIsMatch@(Match,NotMatch)
LKPFROMTODATEIsMatch@Match derive(DW_Run_Key = $G_Dw_Run_Key,
		DW_Create_Dt = $G_Run_End_DT,
		EmployeeID = iif(isNull(EmployeeID), 0, EmployeeID)) ~> DerivedColumn
LKPFROMTODATEIsMatch@NotMatch sink(input(
		ErrorColumn as integer,
		HolderName as string,
		DepartmentNo as string,
		HolderNo as string,
		ErrorCode as integer,
		GetCardFlag as boolean
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ErrorColumn,
		HolderName,
		DepartmentNo,
		HolderNo,
		ErrorCode,
		GetCardFlag)) ~> FlatFileDestination
DerivedColumn derive(GetCardFlag = GetCardFlag,
		EmployeeID = toLong(EmployeeID),
		HolderNumber = HolderNo) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion,LookupLKPTABLE lookup(HolderNumber == Holder_Number,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup select(mapColumn(
		GetCardFlag = GetCardFlag,
		DW_Run_Key = LookupLKPTABLE@DW_Run_Key,
		DW_Create_Dt = LookupLKPTABLE@DW_Create_Dt,
		HolderNumber = HolderNumber,
		CardNo = CardNo,
		HolderName = HolderName,
		EmployeeID = LookupLKPTABLE@EmployeeID,
		HolderNo = HolderNo,
		FromDate = FromDate,
		ToDate = ToDate,
		DepartmentNo = DepartmentNo,
		HolderNo1 = HolderNo1,
		Dw_Holder_Key = Dw_Holder_Key,
		Holder_Number = Holder_Number,
		Holder_Name = Holder_Name,
		Card_Number = Card_Number,
		From_Dt = From_Dt,
		To_Dt = To_Dt,
		Card_Flag = Card_Flag,
		LastUpdate_Dt = LastUpdate_Dt
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Lookup0
Lookup0 split(isMatch(), disjoint: true) ~> LookupIsMatch@(Match,NotMatch)
LookupIsMatch@Match sink(input(
		HolderName as string,
		GetCardFlag as boolean,
		HolderNumber as string,
		FromDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ToDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		EmployeeID as long,
		CardNo as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		HolderName = Param_0,
		GetCardFlag = Param_1,
		HolderNumber = Param_6,
		FromDate = Param_2,
		ToDate = Param_3,
		EmployeeID = Param_4,
		CardNo = Param_5)) ~> OLEDBCommand
LookupIsMatch@NotMatch sink(input(
		DW_Create_Dt as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Holder_Name as string,
		Holder_Number as string,
		Card_Number as string,
		To_Dt as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Card_Flag as boolean,
		DW_Run_Key as integer,
		EmployeeID as integer,
		From_Dt as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		DW_Create_Dt,
		Holder_Name = HolderName,
		Holder_Number = HolderNumber,
		Card_Number = CardNo,
		To_Dt = ToDate,
		Card_Flag = GetCardFlag,
		DW_Run_Key,
		EmployeeID,
		From_Dt = FromDate)) ~> OLEDBDestination
